items.title: Billie Pierce and De De Pierce Interview, 1959-10-07
items.q: No, he was much older than Dean, man.

ctx.x: Ernest Crump was a banjo? Yeah, banjo. Did you all work with him ever, Ernest Crump?
No, he was much older than Dean, man.
I just knew his son, Crump. I did play a job. Maybe you did. I did, I did.
